title: Earlier undisclosed events before WWII

tellings.quote: I mean, there's some other stuff, too, that I can't talk about that was way before that.

plain: There were events going back much further than the ones he can discuss, events he says he is not allowed to talk about, according to a guest named David Grusch. He tells Michels only that "there's some other stuff, too, that I can't talk about that was way before that," which would push the story back to around or before the Second World War.
